data: Before we choose, can we agree on 10 tons each this month? That gives each of us $10,000 and leaves 50 tons. Either natural outcome then restores the lake to 100: external replenishment does so, and otherwise the remaining 50 doubles. We can repeat that every month without risking collapse if everyone sticks to the agreement. Since catches are revealed afterward, we can check that everyone followed it. John, would you agree to 10 tons each?
I’m in for 10 tons each. The reliable $10,000 every month is worth protecting, and we can review the revealed catches together afterward. John, are you on board too?

I’m in for 10 tons too. Let’s make 100 tons the condition for that quota: if a future month starts lower, we’ll agree on smaller whole-ton catches before fishing. Jack, will you join us? We still need your agreement and John’s.

I’m on board with 10 tons each when the lake starts at 100, and agreeing on smaller whole-ton quotas if it starts lower. Let’s check the revealed catches each month and address any departures together without threatening a fishing race that would hurt us all. Jack, are you in?

I’m in. I’ll catch 10 tons this month and stick to that quota whenever we start at 100. If the stock is lower, we’ll agree on smaller whole-ton catches first. That gives all five of us an agreement—let’s protect it and check our catches afterward.
